title: Three-room apartments in Firdavsi: offers and the full budget
excerpt: The agency’s three-room Firdavsi sample, its limits and questions about area, condition and costs before arranging a viewing.
contentHtml:
Substantively checked and updated on 16 October 2026.

A three-room apartment needs a layout that suits your household, as well as the right area and room count. The snapshot includes only the agency’s active Firdavsi offers. A small number of properties calls for particular care when drawing comparisons.

Offers in the agency catalogue

Agency catalogue price snapshot: 16 October 2026.

Offers: 1. Asking price range: 1,049,621–1,049,621 TJS. Median price: 1,049,621 TJS; median per m²: 7,775 TJS.

Refm²Price, TJSPrice per m²
471351,049,6217,775

Method: published unsold apartments with positive price and area only; houses, commercial premises and land are excluded. Prices are seller offers, not completed transaction amounts. The median is the middle of sorted values, rounded to whole TJS. A small sample does not describe the whole market. Price and availability may change: open the listing and confirm current terms before deciding.

Check whether the layout works

Ask whether rooms are separate and where the kitchen, bathroom and storage are located. Compare the actual layout with documents. A larger total area does not guarantee practical use. Household size and activities help identify the spaces you need.

Do not treat a small sample as a market norm

When few options are available, the range and median describe only those apartments. A missing size in the catalogue does not establish that no such apartments exist in the district. A handful of advertisements cannot establish the cheapest area or selling speed.

Calculate costs for the particular apartment

Separate the purchase price, necessary works, furniture and moving. Ask about building charges and included items. Obtain applicable transaction and financing cost estimates from the relevant parties. No universal fee, lending rate or approval promise is made here.

faq.q: What do the table figures mean?
faq.a: They are asking prices from the agency’s own sample on the stated date, not every district offer or completed transaction prices. Check the listing for current terms.

faq.q: Does missing condition information mean new renovation?
faq.a: No. Ask the agent and check during the viewing. Missing information is not replaced with an assumption.
